prior_trial.run6_ruling: (binding; do not refuse on it). Run 5 PASSED steps 1–4 on `a7e6db7e` + mesh `310144d`: the signed-in lead with the production compact hook; alpha attributed to ITS session with notify-sourced idle after its first turn while a foreign ephemeral notify record arrived (PR #172 proven live); both marker sends `submitted` and explicitly read; both replies received by Claude Code as NATIVE teammate messages before any explicit read; the explicit read/mark producing `consumed_by_read`. Step 5 stopped on two HARNESS faults, both corrected for run 6: (1) INPUT COUNTING: Claude inputs are counted ONLY from the controller's own submissions (`tmux send-keys` into the Claude pane, each reserved before it is sent); the transcript is read for USAGE/cost only and never for counting — the `/compact`'s generated rows (summary, local-command caveat, command echo, local-command output) and the native teammate reply batch are NOT inputs (run 5's `cumulative()` took the maximum of the controller count and every string-valued transcript user row and inflated 4 to 9). The `/compact` itself counts as one input. (2) RESUMABLE ASSIGNMENT FIXTURE: the production hook injects a recovery card only when the member's operational snapshot carries a task with id + subject and status `pending` or `in_progress` (`CompactionReinjectionService::snapshot_has_resumable_task`); run 5's lead had no task, so the hook correctly skipped with `no_resumable_task_context`. Before step 5, the controller must give the lead a real assignment through mesh — `mesh task create` with a subject and `mesh task assign --owner lead` with the five-line assignment card (run as the lead's own mesh identity from the controller, no model turn, not counted as a Claude input), status `in_progress` (accept it the same way if the audit's role/assignment identity needs it) — and record the resulting operational snapshot (task id, subject, status, role) BEFORE the `/compact`. This is the audit's "role/assignment context", never a hand-written recovery snapshot. Then step 5: one `/compact`; require the real hook boundary (`compaction.claude_hook.received/resolved/delivered`), a new context generation and card identity, and the recovery card in Claude's native context/transcript naming the current role/assignment identity; observation window >= 120 s. Step 6: one fresh reply marker (FERN) from alpha; Claude receives and acts on it exactly once after recovery, with no terminal-delivery receipt for Claude and no drain descriptor enabled; export; teardown. Run 6 keeps the fresh budget (<= 8 Claude inputs incl. the compact, <= 12 Codex inputs, <= USD 2 metered; compact spend recorded as unknown if the summarizer has no usage row — unknown is never a stop); earlier attempts' spend is history; never stop for a budget, metering or authorization question. Evidence under `l1-claude-lead/run6/`; headline = the latest verdict; mark run 5's headline as superseded by run 6.
